---
title: "Learning Robot Learning"
subtitle: "Concepts, pictures, and code for ETH Zürich's *Robot Learning* course"
---

This site is an independent, unofficial companion to ETH Zürich's *Robot Learning: From Fundamentals to Foundation Models*, taught by Oier Mees in Spring 2026. The [course page]({{< var course_url >}}) has the lecture recordings, slides, and homework.

Each course week gets one page: the big picture, intuitions, the key equations explained term by term, worked NumPy examples, interactive figures, a PyTorch sketch of the core algorithm, and summaries of the papers and the guest talk.

*The site is under construction. The week pages are stubs for now.*
